about: Round 50 (should): the stored form of each field of a PAP write. Each case writes one field in one state (absent, null, empty, padded with whitespace, of another JSON type, the documented default sent explicitly) and reads it back. Each case runs in a fresh tenant of its own, writes to a domain and an externalId of its own; a control writes and reads back first and last.
